description: This file implements the 'multierr' package for error aggregation in Go, providing functions to combine, append, and manage multiple errors, including support for deferred error handling and error formatting.

classes.name: multiError
classes.description: A struct representing an error that contains multiple underlying errors, supporting formatting and error retrieval.

methods.name: Errors
methods.description: Returns a slice of errors contained within the error, or nil if none.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the multiError, formatted either as single-line or multi-line.

methods.name: Errors
methods.description: Returns the list of underlying errors in the multiError.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Formats the multiError for printing, supporting detailed (%+v) and simple (%v) formats.

methods.name: writeSingleline
methods.description: Writes the error message in a single line, separated by semicolons.

methods.name: writeMultiline
methods.description: Writes the error message in a multi-line, indented format.

methods.name: writePrefixLine
methods.description: Helper function to write a string with a prefix before each line after the first.
